column1: Source: kaikki.org machine-readable English dictionary (Wiktionary), extracted 2026-10-03 from the enwiktionary 2026-09-02 dump. Pulled 2026-10-07.
License: Wiktionary text is CC BY-SA — credit Wiktionary contributors if definitions are published; check share-alike terms for commercial books.
One row per dictionary entry (word + part of speech). Tabs split entries by first letter; # holds entries starting with non-letters.
Filter the Note column to hide inflected/variant forms (plurals, past tenses, alternative spellings) when picking headwords for books.
Topics come from Wiktionary categories (e.g. zoology, botany) — useful for themed volumes.
